title: Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 — Statute profile
subject: Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002
summary: Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 is a statute of United States enacted in 2002, in the area of securities. Corporate accountability law passed after major accounting scandals. It is formally cited as Pub. L. 107-204.
key_points: Core effect: Corporate accountability law passed after major accounting scandals.
Status: landmark statute of United States.
guidance: General information only, not legal advice. Use the citation to look up the current official text; statutes are amended over time.
